passive.name: Stage Presence
passive.description: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.

spells.name: High Note
spells.description: Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing magic damage, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to damage below % Health.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation ExplosionDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Surround Sound
spells.description: Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them Move Speed, herself decaying Move Speed and both Shield for seconds. If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring % missing Health to them after a second delay.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Beat Drop
spells.description: Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by % for seconds. Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation FinalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Encore
spells.description: Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for seconds and deals magic damage. Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation R1TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
